command: npm test; dsh dsh-awr-dev --from-default-profile headless; dsh plugin --profile dsh-awr-dev add link:<repo>; dsh dsh-awr-dev --dump-config; dsh dsh-awr-dev "say ok" with and without a control package

checks.name: Package manifest, exports and tests
checks.details: The package is plain ESM with no build step. package.json declares dsh.bundle.patch ./cordis.patch.yml and exports ., ./locale/*.json and ./icon; index.js exports name and apply. npm test ran 6 tests, 6 passed, covering the manifest, exported display resources, sentence-case titles, the icon size limit, and apply against a stub context that rejects any use of ctx other than logger.
criteria: The package builds, declares its dsh manifest in package.json, and exports name and apply.

checks.name: Local link install, composition dump and activation
checks.details: A dev profile created from the headless template had the package installed by dsh plugin add link:. The composed tree from dsh --dump-config lists the plugin's layer and row. Booting the profile printed no entry did not activate warning for it. A control package built the same way printed from its apply on stderr, so the loader calls apply for a linked bundle. Not observed: the skeleton's own log line, because ctx.logger output is not shown by the headless profile at its default level; this and the fact that the desktop app was not used are stated in docs/dsh-010-skeleton-check.md.
criteria: After a local link install, the plugin appears in the DSH composition dump and its apply function runs.

checks.name: Test command documented
checks.details: README.md has a Develop section naming npm test (Node's built-in runner, no dependencies); it was run locally and passed. No CI is configured for this repository.
criteria: A test command runs in CI or locally and is documented in README.md.
